visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male character with short dark hair, wearing a black oversized t-shirt, walks through a modern, brightly lit hallway with neutral tones. He looks back at the camera and gestures towards a room. A digital graphic of a man in a suit (Chef Ahn Sung-jae) is overlaid on the frame. (2) The setting shifts to a promotional area with a white background featuring the 'SAMSUNG' logo. The man speaks directly to the camera with expressive facial expressions and frequent hand gestures. Thumbnails of various YouTube videos appear as overlays behind him. (3) A brief reaction shot of a female character with long dark hair eating spicy food in a dimly lit indoor setting is shown as a cutaway. (4) The main character is seen standing next to Chef Ahn Sung-jae in front of a Samsung backdrop. The character holds a purple foldable smartphone, demonstrating the external screen's use for selfies. They both smile and pose for a camera, forming a '7' shape with their hands. (5) They are seen looking at the unfolded large screen of the device together. The main character points at his YouTube channel interface on the screen. The video concludes with a stylized graphic '要訂閱失敗' (Subscription Failed) with a lightning bolt effect as the Chef gestures that he doesn't have his phone.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Fast-paced, high-energy Mandarin speech by a male speaker begins immediately. Upbeat, rhythmic electronic BGM with a steady kick drum provides a consistent backdrop. A soft 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the visual transition. (2) The narration continues with high pitch variability and excitement. Digital UI 'pop' and 'click' sound effects are inserted rhythmically to punctuate talking points and text appearances. (3) A second male voice (Chef Ahn) enters with a lower pitch, speaking English and Korean with a calm, friendly tone. Sounds of a camera shutter 'click-clack' are clearly audible during a photo-taking moment. (4) The two male voices interact, creating a bilingual dialogue overlay. The BGM maintains its tempo, creating a professional but lively atmosphere. Background room tone and very faint murmurs from other people in the venue are detectable. (5) A sharp, synthesized 'electric zap' or digital glitch SFX plays during the final humorous moment, followed by a quick musical swell and a hard cut to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Premise -> Storytelling -> Interaction -> Climax -> Result
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an integrated promotional piece for the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold smartphone. By leveraging the 'Culinary Class Wars' (黑白大廚) trend, the creator (Joeman) attempts a challenge to get Chef Ahn Sung-jae to subscribe to his channel. He demonstrates the phone's unique features—like the outer screen preview and large inner display—in a natural, high-energy vlog format that appeals to tech-savvy and entertainment-focused audiences.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Prominent display of the Samsung logo, detailed demonstration of foldable phone features, and direct tagging/mentioning of the product context.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively utilizes social media editing trends (fast cuts, variety text, meme SFX) to maintain high retention while performing a commercial endorsement.
